text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: we need a short deprecation banner + migration playbook for v1 -> v2. There are a couple of unexpected SDK behaviors and a busted embed snippet that could confuse users. Goal: public notice early next week.

Marisol Rivera: Ill draft the banner + a micro-FAQ. Thinking: one-page quick migration checklist + link to a deeper guide for edge cases. Anyone opposed? :+1:

Jordan Patel: Agreed. Quick checklist should include: model alias mapping, embed dimension validation, pinning old aliases for rollback, and a note about strict param validation in v2 SDKs. Keep top-level copy <4 bullets.

Liam O'Neil: Technical note: v2 SDK now errors on unknown kwargs (previously ignored). This broke a few community examples where folks pass extra config. We should show a tiny compatibility shim, e.g.:
```js
// shim: silently drop unknown params for client codebases
function safeCreate(client, opts) {
  const allowed = ['model','input','max_tokens','temperature']
  const filtered = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(opts).filter(([k]) => allowed.includes(k)))
  return client.generate(filtered)
}
```
Include this in the migration deep dive.

Sophie Grant: I found the snippet in embeddings that fails: it reads `res.dimension` but v2 returns `res.embedding.length`. Current TS snippet:
```ts
const out = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-alpha', input: 'hello' })
console.log(out.dimension)
```
I'll open a PR to fix both ts/py examples and add a one-line note in the changelog.

Docs Bot: PR opened by Sophie: branch `docs/fix-embed-dims-3123` (#4273)  pre-commit checks passed.

Marisol Rivera: Great. Sophie, can you also add a test in snippets-smoke that asserts `embedding.length` exists? We want CI to catch regressions.

Sophie Grant: Yep. Adding a tiny mocha test and will tag reviewers.

Jordan Patel: Rollback pattern for Dedicated customers: pin alias to `rwd-embed-v1-stable`, set routing policy to use dedicated pool. Add explicit curl + TS example. Example curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-embed-v1-stable\",\"input\":\"...\"}'
```
And TS:```ts
await client.models.pinAlias('my-workspace', 'embed-main', 'rwd-embed-v1-stable')
```
We should explain where to check alias -> actual model mapping in Console.

Liam O'Neil: Also call out a perf caveat: if teams switch to quantized v2 variants they may see small latency increases on cold paths; point them to Optimize guide and our perf matrix.

Alex Chen: Reviewer assignments: @Marisol tone & rollout copy, @Jordan rollback examples, @Liam technical accuracy. Can we get PRs ready for review by Fri EOD? If anything blocks the notice, we hold.

Marisol Rivera: I'll draft the banner this afternoon and post here. Will keep it short with links to quickstart + deep dive.

Sophie Grant: PRs planned: docs/snippets/embed-dim-fix, docs/migration/compat-shim, docs/banners/deprecate-v1. Will tag with reviewers and add smoke test.

Staging Bot: Snippet smoke test scheduled at 3123460000. Will post results to this thread.

Jordan Patel: One more edge: alias names reused across teams caused a dim mismatch in a customer test. Recommend adding a validation step in the quickstart: call the embeddings endpoint with a known vector and assert dimension matches expected before switching aliases. Show sample curl for that.

Liam O'Neil: I'll add a one-page checklist in the migration guide with commands, validation steps, and a fallback snippet.

Alex Chen: Thanks. Sophie, drop the PR links here when ready and we'll triage reviews. We'll do a final check Friday morning in docs channel. :rocket:
